title: Contract Pricing Agreement Close-Out of Discontinued Items: Usage Concession
content:
Usage concession on a discontinued item's close-out — Contract Pricing Agreement

The usage concession follows the units of the discontinued item shipped to the customer's ship-tos less than 12 whole months before the handling date, as the shipments on the customer's Ship-To Fulfillment Account records show them. Whole months between two dates are the difference in calendar months between them, less one when the later date's day of the month is earlier than the earlier date's.

| Units shipped in the window | Concession |
|---|---|
| 500 or more | 1.0 percent off |
| At least 200 and fewer than 500 | 0.5 percent off |
| Fewer than 200 | Nothing off |

An amount equal to that percent of the close-out price is taken off the close-out price before its rounding to four decimal places.

Hypothetical example: 320 units shipped and a close-out price of 20.0000: 0.5 percent of 20.0000 is 0.1000, giving 19.9000.
